svg.title: My Stack — an orbital archive
svg.desc: Hand-drawn technology sigils float on illuminated orbital paths around a suspended glass crystal. Pink, lavender and pale blue outlines, depth, counter-rotating trails, and a responsive composition. Rust, Go, Zig, Bash, C, C++, Kotlin, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Astro, React, Vue, Tailwind CSS, Vite, Three.js, Node.js, Gradle, Android Studio, PyTorch, OpenCV, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, Redis. Every glyph is a custom vector illustration.
